source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.4.4, printed pages 157-158.

blocks.text: Rate constant kisi khas darja hararat par kisi khas reaction ke liye makhsoos hai. Kyunke concentrations mol dm-3 mein aur rate mol dm-3 s-1 mein hai, k ki units reaction ke order aur waqt ki unit par munhasir hain. rate = k [reactants]^n se k = rate / [reactants]^n = (mol dm-3 s-1) / (mol dm-3)^n, to k = (mol dm-3)^(1-n) s-1, ya k = (concentration)^(1-n) s-1, jo kisi bhi order ke liye units deta hai.

blocks.caption: Order ke mutabiq k ki units

blocks.prompt: 25 degrees C par ek rate constant 3.5 x 10^-4 s-1 hai. Reaction ka order kya hai, reactant 0.50 mol dm-3 hone par initial rate kya hai, aur concentration dugni karne par rate ko kya hota hai? Chemists order aur rate constant kyun chahte hain?
blocks.explanation: s-1 units ka matlab pehla order. Initial rate = k [A] = 3.5 x 10^-4 x 0.50 = 1.75 x 10^-4 mol dm-3 s-1. Concentration dugni karne se rate dugni hoti hai. Order aur k janna chemist ko kisi bhi concentrations mein rate ka andaza lagane, kisi amal ke liye iqtisadi halaat chunne, aur mechanism nikalne deta hai, jo akela balanced muadla nahi de sakta.

items: k = (mol dm-3)^(1-n) s-1: zero order mol dm-3 s-1, pehla order s-1, doosra order dm3 mol-1 s-1, teesra order dm6 mol-2 s-1; k ki units order zahir karti hain.
